ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes, 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the perimeter and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field in the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a solid band along the entire trailing edge and tips. High-contrast black streaks and mottling radiate vertically from the obscured peduncle attachment point into the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees; the absolute vertex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge contains three distinct, high-amplitude macro-notches (deep irregular indentations) between the notch and the tip. The left lobe exhibits more consistent, lower-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular dark pixel clusters (diameter approx. 5-10 pixels) are localized in the lower white regions of both lobes, particularly the right lower quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear marks on the left lobe (mid-section) and multiple diagonal scratches on the right lobe that interrupt the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged trailing edge deformities on the right lobe, consistent with major physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated black 'comma' or 'teardrop' shaped marking is visible in the mid-latitudinal region of the right lobe.
